pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bahū patte sannicayaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.3: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā bahū patte sannicayaṃ karissanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.5: pattavaṇijjaṃ vā samaṇā sakyaputtiyā karissanti āmattikāpaṇaṃ vā pasāressantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.6: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.7: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū atirekapattaṃ dhāressantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.9: athakho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.10: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave atirekapattaṃ dhārethāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.13: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā atirekapattaṃ dhāressatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.14: netaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.15: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.16.1: yo pana bhikkhu atirekapattaṃ dhāreyya nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.17: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:2.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato ānandassa atirekapattouppanno hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:2.2: āyasmā ca ānando taṃ pattaṃ āyasmato sāriputtassa dātukāmo hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:2.10: kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabbanti. athakho āyasmā ānando
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:2.13: navamaṃ vā bhagavā divasaṃ dasamaṃ vāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:2.14: athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:2.16: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:2.17.1: dasāhaparamaṃ atirekapatto dhāretabbo taṃ atikkāmayato nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.7: tayo pattassa vaṇṇā ukkaṭṭho patto majjhimo patto omako patto.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.8: ukkaṭṭho nāma patto aḍḍhāḷhakodanaṃ gaṇhāti catubhāgaṃ khādanīyaṃ tadūpiyaṃ byañjanaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.9: majjhimo nāma patto nāḷikodanaṃ gaṇhāti catubhāgaṃ khādanīyaṃ tadūpiyaṃ byañjanaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.10: omako nāma patto patthodanaṃ gaṇhāti catubhāgaṃ khādanīyaṃ tadūpiyaṃ byañjanaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.14: nissajjitabbo saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.16: tena bhikkhunā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassa vacanīyo
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.17: ayaṃ me bhante patto dasāhātikkanto nissaggiyo
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.23: ayaṃ patto itthannāmassa bhikkhuno nissaggiyo saṅghassa nissaṭṭho.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.24: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho imaṃ pattaṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno dadeyyāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.25: tena bhikkhunā sambahule bhikkhū upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassu vacanīyā
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.26: ayaṃ me bhante patto dasāhātikkanto nissaggiyo
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.32: ayaṃ patto itthannāmassa bhikkhuno nissaggiyo āyasmantānaṃ nissaṭṭho.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.33: yadāyasmantānaṃ pattakallaṃ āyasmantā imaṃ pattaṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno dadeyyunti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.34: tena bhikkhunā ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassa vacanīyo
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.35: ayaṃ me āvuso patto dasāhātikkanto nissaggiyo
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.51: nissaggiyaṃ pattaṃ anissajjitvā paribhuñjati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.56: antodasāhaṃ adhiṭṭheti vikappeti vissajjeti nassati vinassati bhijjati acchinditvā gaṇhāti vissāsaṃ gaṇhāti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:4.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū nissaṭṭhapattaṃ na denti. bhikkhū
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:4.3: na bhikkhave nissaṭṭhapatto na dātabbo yo na dadeyya āpatti dukkaṭassāti.
